PBGC design system reference

Version 1.9.0. One file, no dependencies, no network calls. Built from tokens/tokens.json and src/styles/components.css.

The PBGC style guide defines no dark theme. The dark theme here is provisional and must not ship without COLA approval.

Ratios are computed at build time against white. Source: PBGC Branding and Editorial Style Guide, September 2025.

Typography

Arial is the universal brand font, Helvetica Neue is preferred on Mac, Garamond is secondary. No web fonts are loaded.

Heading 3, 22px bold

Lead paragraph, 18px. Line length is capped at 60 characters per the style guide.

Body text, 16px (12 pt). PBGC protects the retirement security of about 31 million American workers, retirees, and beneficiaries in both single-employer and multiemployer private sector pension plans.

Garamond long-form, 20px, for fact sheets and reports.

    Toast

    Info and success dismiss themselves after 10 seconds (hover or focus pauses them). Warning and error stay until dismissed.

    Numeric field

    Whole dollars and cents. Commas are optional.

    $
    in dollars

    Between 0% and 100%, up to 4 decimal places.

    %
    percent

    It never rounds what you type: too many decimal places is an error. Up to 15 digits. A percent is in percent units (5.25 means 5.25%).

    Textarea and switch

    Describe the sample situation. The limit is 40 characters.

    The limit is soft: nothing is cut off, and going over is an error that says by how many.

    Sample setting. Takes effect immediately.

    Date field

    Use MM/DD/YYYY, for example 01/15/1960.

    Never guesses: a two-digit year or an impossible date such as 02/30 is an error that says why.

    Contrast

    Every semantic color pair is validated by npm run tokens in both themes. The build fails if any pair drops below its WCAG minimum. See tokens/contrast-report.md for all 65 checks.
